# Aurora policy update

Document notice-aurora. Version 2. Effective from 2026-09-01. Audience: customers. Banana Bank is a simulated bank: this document describes only the policies of the test environment, in euros. Balances and movements come from the customer's bank ledger, never from this document.

## What changes

Aurora moves to a base fee of EUR 6 per month from September 1, 2026 (previously EUR 8). A full waiver to EUR 0 is added for a salary of at least EUR 1,200 and three settled card purchases in the same month.

## What does not change

This update replaces the amounts in historical copies; it does not affect balances or fees already posted to the ledger. Limits and transfer rules are unchanged: see Aurora · fees and conditions (aurora-fees-2026).
